instruction: Software launch locations: FreeCAD: `/usr/bin/freecad`; LibreCAD: `/usr/bin/librecad`; KiCad: `/home/user/Applications/kicad-10.0.2/kicad-10.0.2-x86_64.AppImage`. Choose the appropriate tool from FreeCAD, LibreCAD, and KiCad, available in the current Ubuntu environment, to complete the task. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/gui20_fixture_edit_seed.dxf. Change the center slot width from 12 mm to 18 mm while keeping slot length 80 mm and slot center at (90,45). Change the four corner holes from diameter 8 mm to diameter 10 mm while keeping centers (25,20), (155,20), (25,70), and (155,70). Add one new center circular hole, diameter 20 mm, centered at (90,45). Save as /home/user/Desktop/gui20_fixture_edit_completed.dxf.
